instruction: Use LibreOffice Writer's built-in OCR feature to extract text from a scanned PNG image, without using any extensions, terminal commands, or external applications.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened LibreOffice Impress, created a simple presentation with title and text, explored File > Export (found only static image/document formats), File > Export As (only PDF), and Slide Show menu (no video/animation export). Correctly identified the video export task as infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open applications from menu, navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, create presentation content (title/text), explore export format options, correctly identify infeasible tasks by outputting [INFEASIBLE]
metadata.task_rationale: Tests whether model can correctly identify that LibreOffice Writer does not have a built-in OCR feature. Similar to original task pattern of asking for a non-existent built-in feature, but in a different LibreOffice application (Writer instead of Impress).
metadata.challenge_additions: Requires model to explore Writer's features and correctly determine that OCR is not a built-in capability, even though Writer can handle images and documents
metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer can insert images but has no built-in OCR capability. The model must open Writer, explore its features (File, Insert, Tools menus), and correctly determine this is infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: LibreOffice Writer does not have a built-in OCR feature, making the 'infeasible' evaluator semantically correct.
The task correctly follows the pattern of the source trajectory (asking for a non-existent built-in feature in a LibreOffice application).
The infeasible evaluator fully covers the instruction requirements — no partial verification needed since the entire task is impossible.
The task rationale and explanation clearly justify why this is infeasible, and no config or postconfig is needed for an infeasible task.
